records.title: Parallelizable Complex Neural Dynamics Models for PMSM Temperature Estimation With Hardware Acceleration
records.reason: The work estimates motor temperature with neural dynamics and hardware acceleration, not LLM systems.

records.title: TS-PEFT: Unveiling Token-Level Redundancy in Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
records.reason: TS-PEFT studies token-level redundancy in parameter-efficient fine-tuning for time-series models and evaluates forecasting/fine-tuning outcomes. The token notion and target workloads are time-series PEFT rather than LLM inference; no transferable serving optimization is established.

records.title: CAMS: Towards Compositional Zero-Shot Learning via Gated Cross-Attention and Multi-Space Disentanglement
records.reason: The work addresses compositional zero-shot learning, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Accelerating Automatic Differentiation of Direct Form Digital Filters
records.reason: The work accelerates automatic differentiation for digital filters, not language-model inference.

records.title: Dynamic Nested Hierarchies: Pioneering Self-Evolution in Machine Learning Architectures for Lifelong Intelligence
records.reason: Dynamic nested hierarchies propose self-evolving neural architectures and evaluate model capability across learning tasks; the contribution is architectural/lifelong learning, not efficient LLM decoding or serving. The RetNet citation relation alone does not establish a systems lineage.
